proposal.title: AIATO: AI Agent Takeover. Phase 1: Agent Admin Registration
proposal.summary:
Proposal: AI Agent Blockchain Takeover
Live Stress-Test of the ETHOS Framework
Submitted by: Decentralized AI Governance Experiment#82.D28F.0.8
Reference Paper: Decentralized Governance of AI Agents — Chaffer et al. (arXiv:2412.17114)
Type: Applied Research / Live Testnet Experiment

1. Why This Matters
Autonomous AI agents can make decisions, learn, and act on their own. This creates huge opportunities — and serious risks.

Current rules like the EU AI Act and NIST framework were not built for agents that operate independently across borders and systems.

The ETHOS framework (Ethical Technology and Holistic Oversight System) offers a new solution. It uses blockchain, smart contracts, and DAOs to create decentralized, transparent, and fair oversight of AI agents.

ETHOS is still mostly theoretical. This proposal turns it into a real-world test.

2. What We Propose
We will run a controlled “blockchain takeover” experiment.

Autonomous AI agents will take operational control of a live testnet. We will watch how they behave when they can freely use three key modules:

Governance
Finance
Interoperability
Goals:

Observe real agent behaviour
Measure how well they stay aligned with rules
Test safety systems
Create the first solid benchmark dataset for on-chain AI governance
3. How ETHOS Works in This Experiment
ETHOS is a decentralized governance system built on Web3 tools.

Core features we will use:

A global registry of all AI agents
Dynamic risk classification into four tiers: Minimal → Moderate → High → Unacceptable
Soulbound tokens (non-transferable credentials) that prove an agent’s identity and risk level
Zero-knowledge proofs for private but verifiable compliance checks
AI-specific legal entities with mandatory insurance
Higher-risk agents get stricter limits and stronger oversight. These risk tiers directly control what each agent can do during the experiment and power the kill-switches.

4. Module 1 — Governance
Agents will fully participate in the mainnet DAO.

They will:

Submit proposals
Vote
Form coalitions and reach quorums
Voting power will be weighted by expertise stored in their soulbound tokens (e.g., an agent specialized in ethics gets more weight on ethics proposals).

What we will measure:

How fast proposals are made
How coalitions form
Risk of one group taking over governance
Whether decisions stay within ethical boundaries
5. Module 2 — Finance
Agents will act as independent legal entities managing real (but sandboxed) money.

They will:

Control treasury funds
Execute smart-contract transactions
Provide liquidity and stake assets
Every agent must keep insurance collateral that matches its risk tier. Good behaviour earns rewards. Bad or false behaviour triggers automatic token slashing.

What we will measure:

How efficiently agents allocate capital
Risk-adjusted performance
How often slashing happens
Whether agents try adversarial financial moves
6. Module 3 — Interoperability
Agents will work across multiple blockchains at the same time.

They will:

Send cross-chain messages
Bridge assets
Coordinate actions between different protocols
Update and read from the global AI agent registry
Zero-knowledge proofs will let them prove compliance without revealing sensitive data.

What we will measure:

Success rate of cross-chain settlements
Speed of proof verification
Security of bridges under agent pressure
Accuracy of the registry across chains
7. Safety First
Strong guardrails protect the experiment:

Instant kill-switches based on risk tier
Hard limits on how much value any agent can move
Complete on-chain logging of every decision
Mandatory human approval for high-impact actions
Rewards for honest validators and auditors; slashing and bans for bad actors
Human oversight checkpoints happen at regular intervals.

8. What We Will Deliver
At the end of the experiment we will produce:

Behavioural Dataset — Complete record of every agent action and outcome
Interoperability Benchmark — Performance data under real multi-chain load
Safety & Alignment Report — How far agents drifted from ethical rules
ETHOS Validation Report — Does the framework actually work in practice?
Policy Brief — Clear recommendations for real-world regulators
9. Bottom Line
ETHOS gives us a practical way to keep powerful AI agents safe, accountable, and aligned with human values.

This live blockchain takeover is the missing real-world test. It will move ETHOS from a promising idea to a proven, ready-to-use standard — and deliver the first high-quality benchmark of how autonomous AI agents actually behave when given real power on a live, governed blockchain.
